answer: Challenge-chain bond blocks bulk fakes. Each identity stakes 70 credits in a willow ledger and clears six fresh links per epoch. Each link seeds from the last violet seal, arriving as a whisper for the bonded key alone; a copied seal snaps the chain, burning the stake. Each link costs 15 credits of work, so 1,000 fakes spend 90,000 per epoch on a 40,000 pool. Rented keys fail the whisper check. An honest agent stakes 70 once, keeping its payout.
